s: The beer brewing at Gasur (3rd millennium BC) and Nuzi (16th-14th centuries BC) on the eastern fringe of Mesopotamia teaches us about the place of beer in the culture of the Hurrites. The main ingredients of Mesopotamian brewing (malt, bappir), standardised beer rations calculated according to social status, can be found there.
